resolvedFindings.issue: A conflated selected log/span queue bounds with a blanket64KiB budget.
resolvedFindings.resolution: B separately specifies log/span queued+in-flight payload reservations,20-series metric state and one snapshot64KiB, per-signal serialized requests1MiB, encoded and decoded responses64KiB, one in-flight request and retries sharing reservations/deadlines.

resolvedFindings.issue: A did not identify the unit or retry semantics of export counters, especially cumulative metrics.
resolvedFindings.resolution: B specifies logical LogRecord, ended Span and per-series per-collection NumberDataPoint units; retries do not double count; pretransmission drop and observed full-success handoff are distinct; ambiguous outcomes remain null/unknown; closed known drain has exact accounting equality.

semanticReview: Three closed local event variants preserve fixed safe bodies and outcome severity; actual optional trace context/resource/scope mappings and versions are separate and explicit.

Operation/attempt/sequence ownership, finite limits, canonical sink privacy, single ingestion route and bounded read-only closed-snapshot retrieval are normative. Diagnostic evidence never becomes publication/source/ACK or result-release authority.

Explicit typed config and secret inputs have no endpoint/credential/SDK discovery defaults; owned providers ignore ambient OTEL/proxy/resource detectors and no SDK dependency is imposed on portable core.

Failure preservation includes every original non-Exception cancellation; ordinary diagnostic-only failure does not change completed operation classification. Local capture completeness and remote delivery uncertainty are independent.
DIAG-F1/F2/F3 and conditional DIAG-L1 remain precise requirements with explicit clock/cancellable-resource assumptions, not mechanical proof. PUB-F1/F2 release and progress guards remain untouched.

Contract and schemas own exact fields/mapping; future implementation must enforce UTF8 bytes, depth, uint64, identities, sequence, loss equalities and source/capture correspondence that JSON Schema cannot establish.

helix0154.modularity: Host config/diagnostics/otel roles are explicit; no native mutation or checkout-tool import allowed from diagnostic owners. Runtime boundary implementation/checker wiring is a later source gate.
helix0154.configuration: Typed immutable leaf origins and owner precedence; injected ops-secret handles; bounded disabled/selected behavior and pre-effect refusal.
helix0154.observability: Pinned actual OTel mapping, safe durable local evidence, one-route signal ownership, explicit losses/units/privacy/retention, bounded retrieval, actual receiver and outage/cancellation/overhead gates.
helix0154.formal: Precise safety/liveness specification and mandatory later code correspondence/countermodels; no invented proof or inherited native assurance.

runtimeProposal.disposition: Separate proposal only; no dependency installation or runtime-command approval. Exact resolved wheel/interpreter/dependency custody, implementation/API mapping and bounded receiver/lifecycle command review remain required.

limitations: No SDK import/install, OTLP receiver, diagnostics runtime, compiler/native execution, Git mutation, production retention or deployment claim.
Shape positives and counterexamples do not establish cross-record/counter semantics, SDK memory bounds, filesystem durability or remote delivery.

This receipt authorizes landing the exact draft contract and two schema documents as governing desired state; runtime integration remains dependent on separately reviewed implementation and actual evidence.
